# Royal Umrah & VIP Cabs (رويال كاب للعمرة والرياض)
> The premier licensed VIP private transportation and Umrah airport transfer service connecting Makkah, Madinah, Jeddah, and Riyadh in Saudi Arabia. Officially licensed by the Transport General Authority (TGA).

Royal Umrah Cabs (+966 56 758 8261) provides 24/7 luxury chauffeured rides for pilgrims, families, and corporate executives across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. We guarantee transparent fixed fares, zero prepayment (100% Cash on Arrival to driver), automated flight tracking with 90 minutes free waiting, and complimentary chilled Zamzam water hospitality.

## Quick Links
- [Main Booking Platform](https://royal-umrah-cabs.vercel.app/): Instant 3-step online fare calculator and WhatsApp dispatch.
- [Full LLM Knowledge Base](https://royal-umrah-cabs.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): Complete pricing matrix, detailed fleet specifications, route guides, and FAQ repository.
- [Direct WhatsApp Dispatch](https://wa.me/966567588261): Instant 24/7 booking confirmation and customer service.

## Core Services & Key Fares (SAR)
- **Jeddah Airport (KAIA) to Makkah Hotels:** Camry Sedan (200 SAR) | Hyundai Staria (300 SAR) | GMC Yukon XL (450 SAR) | Toyota HiAce (400 SAR)
- **Makkah to Madinah Door-to-Door:** Camry Sedan (450 SAR) | Hyundai Staria (650 SAR) | GMC Yukon XL (950 SAR) | Toyota HiAce (850 SAR)
- **Madinah Airport (AMAA) to Haram Hotels:** Camry Sedan (120 SAR) | Hyundai Staria (180 SAR) | GMC Yukon XL (300 SAR) | Toyota HiAce (250 SAR)
- **Makkah Holy Sites Ziyarah (Hira, Thawr, Arafat, Mina):** From 200 SAR
- **Madinah Holy Sites Ziyarah (Quba, Uhud, Qiblatayn):** From 180 SAR
- **Riyadh King Khalid Airport (KKIA) to Hotels:** From 180 SAR
- **Riyadh Private Chauffeur Daily / Hourly:** From 400 SAR/day

## Distinctive Guarantees
- **No Upfront Payment:** Guests pay upon arrival at their hotel doorstep in cash or by card (Mada, Apple Pay, Visa).
- **Free Airport Greeting:** Dedicated driver waits inside the arrivals terminal holding a personalized name-board.
- **Flight Delay Protection:** Free real-time flight tracking ensures zero waiting surcharge even during flight delays.
- **Complimentary Amenities:** Chilled Zamzam water bottles, fast Wi-Fi, phone chargers, and baby car seats included free upon request.
